Results.ReviewText: I am amazed at the difference in the quality and taste of my foods cooked on my Weber.
Results.Title: I never knew it could be so good

Results.ReviewText: Easy to use, cooks at a constant temperature, burners adjust evenly. Superior design to any other barbecue on the market. The Investment is worth it!!!
Results.Title: Great design my congrats to the engineering team

Results.ReviewText: If you are looking for quality and even grilling, this is the grill!
Results.Title: Weber Spirit Grill

Results.ReviewText: Don't be afraid of the small size.  It cooks just as well as it's cousins, the larger ones!  We've had 2 Genesis through the many years.  This grill has all the power of the big boys and half the size.  We grill for 6 adults several times a month....everything fits! I wish we had bought this years ago and saved some money from all the large ones.
Results.Title: Go for it!

Results.ReviewText: I’m a first time gas grill owner. This grill is super easy to use and the perfect size for 2-4 people. I only wish there was more ways to store things in the propane tank area. The quality is what you’d expect from Weber. Very happy.
Results.Title: Very happy with my Weber purchase

Results.ReviewText: My only disappointment is i wish i got the bigger grill.
Results.Title: Grill

Results.ReviewText: This grill replaces my old Weber grill which was over 20 yrs old, and I love it! I’m grilling more often now and love the results !
Results.Title: New Weber Grill

Results.ReviewText: Great grill, heats up quickly and cooks evenly. Small footprint is perfect for a family of 4/6
Results.Title: Great Grill!

Results.ReviewText: We had a very old Weber, same type of grill, but probably 15-20 years old. It was a hand me down and it worked very well until last summer, so we really wanted to get a replacement. Wanted to stick to Weber due to its durability and reputation. Very happy with this choice. It is more than enough for our family!
Results.Title: Great grill!

Results.ReviewText: The grill is better constructed and with heavier sheet metal than my old one.  I like the gas level scale gauge. I like the cast iron grill. I like the warranty. I like the 4 casters so it rolls easily and is level.  I like the fold down side tables.
Results.Title: What I like about Weber grills.

Results.ReviewText: I'm 52 and never owned a weber before but now I will never own anything but a weber it's awesome!
Results.Title: AWESOME!!!!!!!

Results.ReviewText: First Weber propane grill we have owned. Excellent experience.
Results.Title: First and Best

Results.ReviewText: This is a great grill and adds a degree of versatility.  I use it in situations where my pellet grill would be impractical.  I am so pleased that my son bought one as well to augment the pellet grill they have. Thanks!
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.ReviewText: I love it!  I used to think I was just a poor grilled.   Now my food is great!
Results.Title: The best grill I've ever owned.

Results.ReviewText: Excellent product. Starts quickly and temperature control is amazing. First grill that truly lets me control the burn
Results.Title: Great grill and great value

Results.ReviewText: I have been a long time owner of Weber kettle for charcoal grilling and smoking but never owned a Weber gas grill before.  I finally got to the point where I was tired of rebuilding my gas grills every 3-4 years as the pieces wore out and needed replacing.  Plus, over time, the quality just fails.  I have now owned the Spirit for awhile now and will never look back.  The Weber gas grills are every bit as high quality as the charcoal line of products: top notch build quality, perfect balance a heat across the entire grilling surface, infinite control of grill temp....and no flash burning when you aren't looking!  Great results every time.  Very pleased!
Results.Title: Don't waste $$ on a cheap grill.  Get a Weber!

Results.ReviewText: Previous grill was a 15 year old 3 burner Genesis.Family gave me a 3 burner Spirit for my birthday. Virtually same size as my old Genesis . I have to say, I preferred the old style grates, but I'm sure I will adapt.Burners are much hotter than previous, but so far am doing well in my learning curve. Good product, good value.
Results.Title: Replacement for my 15 year old Weber !

Results.ReviewText: First time owning a weber and I couldn't be happier.  The temperature control is better than any other grill I've owned.
Results.Title: Happy Customer

Results.Title: Quality went down and price went up

Results.ReviewText: After the 1st one purchased didn’t work(light) I had to bring it back to Lowe’s, waited a week to get another one and it’s works fine. Nice grill just a hassle to get one that worked.
Results.Title: Weber

Results.ReviewText: Great grill.  Had trouble with a Weber pellet grill and Weber support did everything they could by refunding the cost of the grill and picking up the grill.  Couldn’t ask for more. THANKS WEBER!!
Results.Title: Weber grill and support

Results.ReviewText: This 3 burner grill is great.  I have a small family and this grill works out well for us.   I had a very old Weber genesis grill and replaced it with this.   Only had it for a month and breaking it in now.  No problems installing the propane tank and it fires up all the time.
Results.Title: Great Grill.

We are glad to see that our team could help in making this right! We have passed your feedback to the appropriate team. If you have questions or concerns, do not hesitate to reach out to us! Results.ReviewText: The grill transfers a lot of heat into the handle and to the side shelves my cook box actually melted on the right side
Results.Title: Bill kidd

Results.ReviewText: Easy ignition.  What I like most about this grill is the even distribution of heat.  I’ve not had this with other grills.
Results.Title: Spirit E-310 Gas Grill

46510001.Name: Spirit E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46510001.Description:
Add flavor to the menu with a Spirit E-310. It’s the ideal grill for entertaining a small crowd or a perfect solution to any family meal. Place serving trays and spices on the side tables so that everything you need is where you are, when you need it. With features such as porcelain-enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 424 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
